avcaps.selection: First eight unused eligible films by SHA-256 of reel-acoustic-window-01/ plus source ID. 72 previously used IDs excluded. At least three distinct captions per modality. Duration range extended from 4-35 s to 4-70 s before inference because only four unseen films qualified. One source per film.
avcaps.protocol: Freeze 8 unseen AVCaps films by the existing hash-selection protocol, prior to reading responses. Compare the exact same playback packets with and without additional waveform-based YAMNet observations. Local Codex sees pictures, existing AST, CoNeTTE, speech evidence and no attached WAV in both arms. No changes to questions. A fresh anonymous session per arm/film reports uncued first impression, then separate sight and sound recall. Primary endpoint difference in same-minus-other sound caption cosine against independent human sound-only captions; also visual and initial impressions and paired film uncertainty. Do not tune on the holdout. Explore development films separately; include a controlled change in sound with identical pictures, silence and discontinuities. Report neither classifier confidence nor a whole-film description match as an event annotation.
avcaps.reader: Same image bytes, sample and turn bounds in both arms. 8 s maximum per turn, continuous playback. Local AST and CoNeTTE where prepared and speech readings. No WAV sent to GPT; optional 30B waveform reader off in both arms. One isolated reader per film and condition. No caption/answer key in reader context.
avcaps.scoring: Compare the sentence with human descriptions of that film and the other seven using the specified embedding revision. Subtract the other-film mean cosine from the same-film mean cosine. The human reference holds out each human caption in turn. Each scene has equal weight. Use the mean model separation divided by mean human separation for each modality, then weight sight and sound equally as in earlier-observations.json. In a paired film bootstrap use the same eight sampled film indices for both modalities, 10000 resamples, seed 20261123. Ranges reflect film sampling only; other-film contrasts fixed. A value above 1 is possible.

The short-window classifier also missed the crying category in this original film. This film was excluded from the new panel.

controlled_order.protocol: Fold 5 of ESC-10. Sort ten categories and select one file per category by SHA-256 of reel-waveform-order-01/ plus the category or filename. Play both orders of each pair; 5 s sound, 1 s silence, 5 s sound. Two entirely silent clips. Identical gray frames. Two successive turn packets supplied together in one prompt with the same content except for sound_events. Both category names supplied. A/B require both sources and their order; ? means absent or unclear. Fresh local GPT session per arm and case.

street.metric: All eight TUT evaluation recordings. A one-second bin is positive if any part overlaps a human annotation or a predicted support window. Use source-specific AudioSet labels at the shipping score threshold .5 in either recorded channel. Count TP, FP and FN for each class, including zero predictions and the unmapped brake class. Report micro F1 and class counts for AST, YAMNet and their union. No tuning after looking at results.

cutoff_check: Actual 44.1 kHz MCP stdio with --until 1.25: first 0.975 s window ends at native sample 42998 (0.9750113 s). Replay of 0.5-1.25 s returns zero complete windows, replay through 1.3 s rejected.
